---
title: Guide
description: >
  Install Panache, format and lint documents, configure a project, and set up
  editors and automated checks.
---

Start with [Getting Started](../getting-started.qmd) to install Panache and run
your first checks. The guides cover common tasks; the
[Reference](../reference/index.qmd) lists commands, configuration options,
rules, and external-tool presets.

- [Formatting](formatting.qmd): format documents, check layout, and understand
  formatting behavior.
- [Linting](linting.qmd): find problems, apply fixes, and suppress individual
  findings.
- [Configuration](configure.qmd): share project settings and choose external
  formatters and linters for code blocks.
- [Editor Setup](lsp.qmd): connect your editor, configure formatting on save,
  and customize semantic highlighting.
- [Language Server](language-server.qmd): use formatting, diagnostics,
  navigation, completion, and code actions while editing.
- [Integrations](integrations.qmd): run Panache through GitHub Actions,
  pre-commit, and dprint.
- [Performance](performance.qmd): compare measured formatting and linting speed
  on real documents.
- [Comparison](comparison.qmd): compare the features of other formatters,
  linters, and language servers.
